scripts.build: cd packages/core && bun run build && cd ../opencode && bun run build && cd ../pi && bun run build
scripts.test: bun run build && cd packages/opencode && bun run test && cd ../.. && bun test scripts/pack-arcus.test.ts scripts/fork-sync.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: cd packages/core && bun run build && cd ../.. && bun run --cwd packages/e2e-tests test
